title: Galaxies M81 & M82
credit: T.A. Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage) and NOIRLab/NSF/AURA
displayModel: The photograph's light is split by S4G's bulge-plus-disc fit (Salo et al. 2015 (S4G)): the disc's share is decomposed into a midplane residual and a diffuse component spread through 32 slabs with an exponential profile of 368 pc (scale length over 7.3, Kregel et al. 2002); the bulge's is spread through an oblate spheroid sliced in every bank. Depth is modelled, not measured per pixel.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Download the publisher Large JPEG; no crop or resample.
